name: When should I get a professional rain damage roof evaluation?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a professional rain damage roof evaluation?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should get a professional rain damage roof evaluation immediately after experiencing severe weather, such as heavy rainstorms, hail, or strong winds. Even without visible damage, a professional inspection can identify hidden issues that might compromise your roof's integrity over time. Contacting us promptly after a storm allows for a quick assessment and can help with potential insurance claims, as some policies have time limits for reporting damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule an evaluation immediately after severe weather, even if damage isn't obvious. Prompt action assists with potential insurance claims.
